title: Model fit vs prediction performance: contrasting fixed-coefficient models with mixture models
abstract: arXiv:2510.09185v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture models such as mixed logit and latent class routinely achieve large gains in fit on panel data, yet several studies have found that these gains do not carry over to out-of-sample prediction. This paper explains why, building on the distinction between population-level and person-level prediction familiar from statistics. The panel log-likelihood of a mixture is exactly the cumulative score of forecasts that condition each choice on the person's earlier choices. Models are instead usually validated and applied with unconditional forecasts, which use only the estimated distribution of tastes and are scored by the cross-sectional log-likelihood. The difference between the two log-likelihoods, which we call choice consistency, comes from reproducing the dependence between a person's choices, and unconditional forecasts cannot use it. translated_title: 模型拟合与预测性能之辨：固定系数模型与混合模型的对比
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.09185v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：混合模型（如混合Logit模型和潜类别模型）在面板数据上通常能获得显著的拟合优度提升，然而多项研究发现这些提升并未延续到样本外预测中。本文基于统计学中广为人知的总体层面预测与个体层面预测的区别，解释了其中的原因。混合模型的面板对数似然恰好是条件预测的累积得分，其中每一次选择都以该个体之前的选择为条件。然而，模型通常以无条件预测进行验证和应用，无条件预测仅利用估计出的偏好分布，并以横截面对数似然进行评分。我们将这两种对数似然之间的差异称为“选择一致性”（choice consistency），它源于对个体选择之间依赖关系的再现，而无条件预测无法利用这一点。通过将拟合增益分解为选择一致性与异质性两部分，我们展示了当假设的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过区分总体层面与个体层面预测并提出“选择一致性”这一概念，解释了为何混合模型在面板数据上的拟合优度优势无法转化为样本外预测性能的提升。
en_tdlr: This paper explains why mixture models' substantial in-sample fit gains on panel data fail to carry over to out-of-sample prediction by introducing the concept of "choice consistency"—the gap between panel (conditional) and cross-sectional (unconditional) log-likelihoods—which unconditional forecasts cannot exploit.
